examples.code:
Original recording preflight:
- Use a demo account with synthetic data.
- Hide notifications and credential-bearing terminals.
- Capture at a resolution where UI text remains readable after scaling.
- Record 10 seconds; check framing, peaks and caption readability.
- Save a clean master and a delivery copy.
- Record consent, media licenses and export settings.
